meta.title: You Can Tank Your Credit Score Without Missing One Payment
meta.hook: You can hurt your credit score without missing a single payment.
meta.description: Credit utilization — how much of your available credit you're using — is the second-largest factor in the FICO score, weighted around 30%, behind only payment history. Unlike payment history, which takes years to build, utilization is recalculated every billing cycle, so a maxed-out card can swing your score fast even if you always pay in full. Educational content only, not financial advice.
